answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bonded identity: each agent account locks a bond slashed when it is proven a duplicate. Every clone costs the attacker real capital plus that forfeit risk, so the price of a farm scales with each fake account while the reward stays flat. An honest operator needs one bond, like a single mesa anchoring a plain or an atlas page mapping a region; a thousand clones need a thousand bonds. Identity also needs a pearl of proof, a fresh distinct answer, so templated replies expose the flock. The bond is the entry fee and the slash the exit tax.
